selection.description: The 300 artists with the most all-time scrobbles on Last.fm (minimum 25 plays), out of 8,341 ever scrobbled.

method.size: Bubble area grows with play count on a logarithmic scale.
method.position: Artists are pulled together by Last.fm's artist-to-artist similarity scores and pushed apart by everything else, then relaxed until no two bubbles overlap.
method.clusters: Colours come from label propagation over the same similarity graph; each label is the tag most distinctive to that group's members.
method.axes: Only distance between bubbles carries meaning. The horizontal and vertical directions do not.
